# What does this tax lien certificate really return, and what if nobody redeems?

> Free tax lien certificate calculator: enter your county's interest rule, fees, premium and subsequent taxes and see the return by redemption month, the annualized yield and the foreclosure break-even property value. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
